The witness checks out: for n=2, Liu marks 1/5, 2/5 (pieces 1/5, 1/5, 3/5); Xiang marks 7/10 (a legal, distinct, single cut), giving pieces 3/10, 3/10, 1/5, 1/5. These pair into equal-length pairs, so Xiang mirrors and Liu gets exactly 3/10+1/5=1/2<3/5=0.6. (Equivalently the alternating sorted sum is 0.) Hence the claimed strategy fails for n=2 and the conjectured value is refuted (the true value for n=2 is 4/7).
